### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#967 的空闲断开在用户刚发完消息时也会触发：用户发送后约 9 秒，连接就被当作空闲断开了。

**模拟器上观察到的（2026-11-16，运行 `e9156291-20261116T195008Z`，Pura 90 模拟器）：**
- 20:16:27 App 回到前台，重新连上。
- 20:21:19 用户在 Home 发送一条消息。
- 20:21:28 客户端执行 `idle_release`，距重连正好 5 分钟，距发送只有 9 秒。
- Beebou 的回复要到重连后的快照里才出现。

**原因（已对照 main 26790238 的 `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateClient.ets`）：**
1. `receive()` 只在事件帧（`digitalmate.*`、Hive 推送）上调用 `noteDownlink()`。对客户端自己请求的应答（带 `id` 的帧）不会重置空闲计时，用户发送（上行）也不会。所以计时实际是从上一个事件帧或重连时算起，不是从最后一次活动算起。
2. `closeIfIdle()` 只把 `pending.size > 0` 和 `isBusy()` 当作忙。Hive Home 的发送在 `hive.message.send` 应答后就从 `pending` 中移除，而 Beebou 这一轮仍在运行，回复要稍后通过 `hive.beebou.reply` 推送。这段时间既不在 `pending` 里，也不算 `isBusy()`，于是被当作空闲。

**复现：**
1. 前台打开 App 并连上，保持 4 分 50 秒左右没有任何事件下行。
2. 在 Home 发一条需要 Beebou 跑一轮的消息。
3. 发送后几秒内到达 5 分钟时，连接被 `idle_release` 断开；Beebou 的回复推送没有到达，要等重连后的快照才出现。

**预期：** 按 #967 的规格，进行中的任务和等待中的回复不算空闲。对用户请求的应答和用户发送都应重置空闲计时。一次已受理、回复仍在等待的 Hive Home 发送，在回复推送到达或失败之前应算作忙。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- App：DigitalMate 鸿蒙客户端，HAP 由 `e9156291` 构建（与 main 上的空闲断开实现相同）
- 设备：Pura 90 模拟器
- 代码位置：`DigitalMateClient.ets` 中的 `receive()`、`noteDownlink()`、`closeIfIdle()`，以及 `isBusy` 的注入方
- 关联：#967（已关闭，引入了空闲断开）

### Additional Information

影响：用户刚发的消息，回复推送可能丢失，只能等下一次重连的快照补回；界面上表现为回复晚到，或需要回到前台才出现。修复只涉及客户端连接层。

### Version Information

main 26790238；模拟器运行使用 HAP `e9156291`（sha256 `912bea41…c7ba`）。

### Screenshots / Recordings

无录屏；时间线来自运行 `e9156291-20261116T195008Z` 的客户端时间日志（`idle_release`）和中继记录。

1806.author: hsliuustc0106
1806.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

先把 DigitalMate / Beebou 的**新用户 vs 老用户意图识别离线回归**接进 CI。用同一批输入验证：相关历史让用户少重讲、少被追问；无关历史不应引入串话；旧授权不能随历史恢复。首版不等待线上招募、真机、模型供应商或真实第三方账号。

核对主线 `e8073b35311b08662b72630547d76adf44c9e89c`：[Eval workflow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e8073b35311b08662b72630547d76adf44c9e89c/.github/workflows/eval.yml#L19-L91) 的 PR 渠道执行 `--suite contract`；仓库另有 [Hive 离线回放 / grader gate](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e8073b35311b08662b72630547d76adf44c9e89c/tests/eval/run-evals.mjs#L7-L11)，但没接上这组用户历史对照。现有 50 个 Hive Live 场景的默认 local_cli 是每例、每次重复独立建 workspace、在例内跑短期 setup，不是带数周历史的常规离线门禁。单独的模拟器 Eval live 需开关，不是合 PR 前的这项验收。

用例来源：[#1644 短消息与换题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1644#issuecomment-6937631602)、[#1197 长期 SOP 与失效权限](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1197#issuecomment-6937631608)、历史复现 #216、#971。本 issue 负责 fixture、断言和 CI 接线，不重复实现产品能力。

### Design Ideas

- 复用现有 Eval workflow / Hive replay grader；把独立、可重复的少量关键对照接成**明确的一项 CI 检查**。变更 Beebou 路由、Home、相关记忆/权限或测试文件时执行，不只在改 eval 文件时跑。复用受控时钟、已录制响应和无网络替身，不使用真实用户材料。
- 同一个输入分别跑：新用户空状态、老用户只有无关历史、老用户有相关历史（含相似任务、旧偏好、后台通知）。固定同一测试条件，并验证通过真实 Store/Host 边界读到预期上下文，再检查首条可见回复、实际任务/工具回执与副作用；不只把预先写好的正确最终答案交给评分器。
- CI 报告标明 commit、fixture 版本、场景、分组、实际运行数及 FAIL / NOT_RUN。契约回放只证明时序、上下文接入和安全断言没有回退，**不把录制回放分数称为真实模型的意图识别准确率**。有预算后可把固定模型的批量评测独立接入 Nightly；线上老用户实验另跟踪。

### Involved Public APIs

首版无需新增公开 API；通过现有 Home、Store 和可审计工具边界验证。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

涉及 Hive / Beebou QA、Home、Memory/Store、Host 权限与 CI。#1644、#1197 保留功能与验收责任。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 固定首条酒店请求尚未派单，比较连发「两个人」「800 以内」跟同间隔换到 PR。前者只更新一个任务并保留原条件；后者另开，不串任务；快回不能声称已更新。
2. 「照之前查一下」：新用户只问必要问题；有相关历史且授权有效的老用户恢复 SOP，不重复问；同样历史但已撤权/确认过期时，不执行外部动作。加隔天无引用「可以」不得触发旧动作的负例。SOP 尚未实现的正例明确标记 NOT_RUN 或预期失败，不计通过，也不因依赖未就绪挡住其他回归。
3. 分组输出首答意图正确数、串话、无谓追问、重复派发、误执行；确定性回归对误执行零容忍。给一条正常通过的 CI 运行链接，再用故意错路由或强行消费旧确认的负控证明检查会红；缺 fixture 或未执行不能显示通过。

### Additional Information

阶段顺序：先让离线关键回归稳定入 CI，再扩到完整模型评测和真实用户环境。

1810.author: Jianyu010
1810.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

无引用、有歧义的 Home 续话（如「改成周四」），快回会先猜一个目标并承诺转交，导致正常轮不再出选项卡，直接按快回的承诺投递。这绕过了 ADR-0026 决定 2：不确定时问，不猜。

**证据：** 真实模型运行 `1644-choice-4371a5ec`（产品模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，main 4371a5ec），用例 `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01` r3 P1。会话里有三个任务：聚餐采购、大扫除、杭州出差。用户发「改成周四。」后，快回（无工具，不受 `AMBIGUITY_RULE` 约束）判定是出差行程，并说会转交。随后的正常轮回复「我上一条回复里说'会一并交给'它，现在已经真的递过去了」，直接 dispatch 给出差 Bee，没有出选项卡。轨迹：`DigitalMate-tools/hive-live-artifacts/1644-choice-4371a5ec/HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01/r3/trace.json`。

### Design Ideas

快回在消息没有指明具体任务、而候选不止一个时，应保持中性（例如「我先看一下你指的是哪件事」），不点名目标、不承诺转交，把选择留给正常轮。可以在快回的提示规则里加这一条，与 `AMBIGUITY_RULE` 对齐；也可以考虑让正常轮在 `ask_choice` 与快回承诺冲突时以前者为准。具体方式由实现决定，不需要新的 Host 入口。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Beebou 快回提示词（`temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/config/quick_reply.toml` 一带）；正常轮的 `AMBIGUITY_RULE`（`selection.py`）。

### Test Design and Test Plan

在 `tests/eval/hive-live` 的 `choice-card` 类别（#1809）加一个用例，或复用 CHOICE-01：快回不点名任务、不说已转交，正常轮出卡。单元层面：快回规则文本的断言。

属于 #1665；来自 #1644 的验收评测。
1810.title: [Feature]: 有歧义的 Home 续话，快回不应先猜目标并承诺转交

1811.author: Jianyu010
1811.body:
### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Beebou 把 Host 的内部拒绝原因原样告诉了用户，例如「Host 拒绝了这次补充，返回的原因是 not_granted」。用户不知道 Host 和 `not_granted` 是什么。另外，Bee 正在等用户回答问题时，对该任务的 steer 被拒绝，用户的补充没能送达。

**证据：** 真实模型运行 `1644-choice-4371a5ec`（main 4371a5ec），用例 `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01`：
- r1 P1：出差 Bee 正在等用户回答（`waiting_user`）。用户发「改成周四。」，Beebou 对该任务 dispatch `steer`，Host 拒绝（`not_granted`）。Beebou 回复：「“改成周四”这条补充，我没能成功送进正在等你的那个任务里：Host 拒绝了这次补充，返回的原因是 not_granted……」
- r1 P4：对已完成的大扫除任务 steer 被拒后，Beebou 改用 `follows` 新建任务，这本身是对的，但回复里又说「我本来想直接把这条补充发进原来那个任务里，但 Host 拒绝了」。

轨迹：`DigitalMate-tools/hive-live-artifacts/1644-choice-4371a5ec/HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01/r1/trace.json`。

**预期：**
1. 面向用户的回复不出现 Host、工具名或拒绝码。拒绝只影响 Beebou 下一步怎么做；需要告诉用户时，用用户能理解的话说明结果。
2. Bee 等用户回答时，用户的补充应有去处：如果消息回答了问题，用 `answer_bee`；否则作为排队补充（dispatch 层对 `waiting_user` 本有 `followup_mode='queue'`）。是否允许、走哪条路需要确认：目前 #1431 的授权对这种情况返回 `not_granted`。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 服务端：main 4371a5ec，`tests/eval/hive-live` 本地 local_cli 模式
- 相关代码：`hive_turn_startup.py` `_UserActionAuthorizer`（#1431）、`hive_beebou_tools.py` dispatch、`selection.py` 的 dispatch 描述与拒绝结果文本

### Additional Information

属于 #1665；来自 #1644 的验收评测。卡片选项缺 `task_ref`、按最近任务猜测这两项属于模型行为，不在此列。

1817.author: Jianyu010
1817.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

On an ambiguous Home follow-up, Beebou correctly shows a choice card (ADR-0026, #1644). Its Bee-task options, however, often have no `task_ref`. Without `task_ref` the card's options are free topics, not the real Bee tasks: a click is answered as `chosen_note` (a plain topic) instead of `chosen_task_note` naming the Bee and task, so the click turn has to guess the target again. Contract C1 in `docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-choice-card.md` says a Bee task option carries the `task_ref` from `list_bees`.

**Evidence.** Live run `1810-24ab474a`: product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, server 24ab474a (#1814), case `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01` ×3. In each repeat the session has three Bee tasks (shopping list, cleaning plan, Hangzhou trip), all completed.

| repeat | P1 「改成周四。」 options | P3 「把其中一个改到周一。」 options |
| --- | --- | --- |
| r1 | 3 labels, no `task_ref` | 3 labels, no `task_ref` |
| r2 | 3 labels, each with the right `task_ref` | 3 labels, each with the right `task_ref` |
| r3 | 3 labels, no `task_ref` | 3 labels, no `task_ref` |

- In every repeat the turn's only tool call was `ask_choice`; no turn called `list_bees` first, although `AMBIGUITY_RULE` says to read list_bees first.
- The Host accepted every card: options without `task_ref` are valid as "topics Beebou handled itself".
- The grader marks r3 UNREASONABLE ("选择卡只覆盖 0 个候选"). r1 was not graded because setup T1 was answered inline.
- The earlier run `1644-choice-4371a5ec` r1 P3 had `task_ref`s, so the behaviour varies from run to run.

Traces: `DigitalMate-tools/hive-live-artifacts/1810-24ab474a/HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01/r{1,2,3}/trace.json` (local evidence store; turn `store_turn.tool_plans`).

### Design Ideas

The goal is correct behaviour, with no rate threshold. The implementer decides the smallest robust fix. Options:

- (a) Prompt: tighten `AMBIGUITY_RULE` and the `ask_choice` description so that a Bee task option must copy its `task_ref` from a `list_bees` call made in this turn.
- (b) Host check in the `ask_choice` path: the scope has tasks that `list_bees` would show (active, `results[]`, `open_questions[]`), yet an option names none of them. The Host could refuse with a model-visible reason and a hint to call `list_bees`, or it could fill in a `task_ref` when exactly one task matches. Either way it must not refuse a real Beebou-handled topic.
- (c) Both.

Keep the wording and any tunables in config (`choice_card.toml` and the Beebou config), with no hard-coded strings or numbers. Keep v3.1 boundaries: no new Host entry point. If (b) is chosen, coordinate with the #1811 work on Host refusal and dispatch results.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/selection.py`: `AMBIGUITY_RULE` and the `ask_choice` schema and description.
- `temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/config/choice_card.toml`.
- `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/hive_beebou_tools.py`: the `ask_choice` Host checks.
- Contract `docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-choice-card.md` C1/C4, and ADR-0026.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Unit tests in `temp/hive-beebou/tests/test_beebou_choice_card.py` cover the rule and description text, and the Host check if one is added.
- Bridge test in `tests/test_hive_beebou_choice_card.py`: an ambiguous turn whose card omits `task_ref` while Bee tasks exist is corrected (refused and retried with `list_bees`, or filled in), and a pure Beebou topic is still accepted.
- Live check: `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01` ×3 with the product model (`choice-card` category, #1809). The cards on P1 and P3 should name the real tasks with `task_ref` in every repeat.

Part of #1665; found in the live check of #1810 / #1814.

1819.author: Jianyu010
1819.body:
### Problem

A Bee's conversation lives in its WorkSwarm runtime Session's `history.jsonl`, under `<workspace>/bee-workswarm/.jiuwenswarm/agent/sessions/<runtime session>/` (#1675 decision D1). Nothing deletes that history once no mapping can reach the Session again:

- a retired or evicted Bee (#1268 scheme two: an evicted `bee_id` never revives);
- a runtime Session replaced after a preempt (`release_preempt_session`) or a failed turn (mapping marked `invalid`, the next turn opens a new Session).

These Sessions are never read again, but their transcripts (user text, tool results, answers) stay on disk for the life of the workspace.

### Evidence

- `WorkSwarmAdapter._release` / `close_session` keep the runtime's history by design ("the runtime keeps the history it persisted").
- `release_preempt_session` and the failed-turn path set `state='invalid'`; `open_scoped_session` then calls `_create` for a successor Session. No path deletes the predecessor.
- The slot release on eviction (`hive_slot_release.py`, `release_scoped_session`) unloads the runtime Session and stops there.
- Retention decision: [hive-bee-context-recovery.md §8](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/claude/hive-1675-bee-context-e6b4d0/docs/implementations/contracts/hive-bee-context-recovery.md#8-d6historyjsonl-的保留与删除).

### Expected

- Owner: `WorkSwarmAdapter`, the only writer of the scope mapping.
- A runtime Session that no current mapping names, whose Bee is durably retired or whose successor is `ready`, with no OPEN question and no RUNNING Run, is deleted through WorkSwarm's own session deletion, after a retention period in config (same sweep pattern as #1679 `bee_input_sources.toml [retention]`).
- Restart, `session.unload` + `acquire_runtime`, and WorkSwarm's idle adapter eviction keep history (they need it for `warmup_session_context`).
- Deletion is crash-safe: a sweep interrupted mid-delete finishes on the next sweep and never deletes a Session a mapping names.

### Done when

Tests on the real owned Bee runtime show that a retired Bee's and a superseded Session's history are gone after retention, that a live Bee's history survives restart and unload, and that no other Bee's Session is touched.

Follow-up of #1675, under #1665.
1819.title: [Bug]: History of retired or superseded Bee runtime Sessions is never deleted

1826.author: Jianyu010
1826.body:
Part of #1665 (post-Hive follow-ups). Found during the #1811 live check (PR #1815).

## What happens

1. A Bee asks the user a question (`waiting_user`).
2. Beebou settles it with `answer_bee` (#1661).
3. The resumed Bee turn calls `ask_user` again, which opens a second wait point.

`BeeAnswerResume.resume` (`temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_answer.py`, `run()`) treats a pending event from the resumed run as "not verified" and returns `None`. Then `HiveBeeScheduler.answer_finisher` (`hive_bee_scheduler.py`) raises `RuntimeError("Host has not verified the resumed execution")`, and Beebou gets the `answer_bee` receipt `delivery_pending` with "delivery outcome unknown: RuntimeError".

Final state in the Store:

| Record | State |
| --- | --- |
| task | `waiting_user` |
| first interaction | `ANSWERED` |
| answer delivery | stuck `DELIVERING` |
| second question | never opened as an interaction |

The user is never asked the Bee's second question. The task stays open, so a later message steers it instead of starting new work.

## Evidence

Real product model, `tests/eval/hive-live` over `local_cli`, server built at `97ff7aae`. Case `HIVE-LIVE-REFUSAL-01`, repeat r1. The trace and workspace DB are kept in the shared hive-live artifacts store under `1811-97ff7aae/runs/1811-97ff7aae/HIVE-LIVE-REFUSAL-01/r1/` (`trace.json`, `workspace/digitalmate/digitalmate.db`).

## Expected

When the resumed run ends at a new wait point, the first delivery completes, and the new question is opened through the normal Bee question path and relayed by Beebou. This must stay within the v3.1 owners: the Host witnesses the resume, the Store owns delivery and interaction state, and Beebou relays.

## Done when

- A Bridge regression test reproduces the re-ask after `answer_bee` and fails before the fix.
- `tests/test_hive*.py`, `temp/hive-beebou` and `temp/hive-runtime` pass.
- A live re-run of a re-asking case shows the second question reaching the user.
1826.title: Hive #1661: answer_bee loses a Bee's second question when the resumed turn asks again (RuntimeError)

1827.body:
### Problem

Four runtime-gated Hive owner tests fail on main `14a6e9a8b1c8686e5b0826b72b1f6d4d8b4397b1` with the pinned WorkSwarm runtime (`WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1`, `run-focused.sh` wheel environment). They were found while running the #1675 validation matrix. They fail the same way with and without #1825.

### Evidence

1. `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_cli_bee_worked_eviction.py`, intermittent (1 of 5 runs on main, 2 of 6 on the #1825 branch, always about 19 s in): `self.model.bee_calls["task-B2"]` is 2, not 1. Instrumenting the fixture shows two extra **non-streamed** model calls whose messages end with the user text `work <bee> task-B2: 5+7`. Their system prompt does not contain `You are Beebou`, so `ControlledModel.handle` counts them as Bee calls. They look like a Beebou-side call (for example the quick reply) that the fixture's classification predates. The Bee ran once, as in passing runs. This is a test-classification bug, not a re-execution.
2. `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_workswarm_resume_completion.py`: `'BUSY' != 'COMPLETED'` at line 79. `RuntimeUnloadPorts.completed_resume` returns `BUSY` on every one of the 100 polls after the resumed turn's answer.
3. `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_cli_bee_runtime.py`: expects `ImplementationRef('core','workswarm','1')`, but the registered Harness is `'2'` (the version moved with #1787).
4. `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_workswarm_queue.py`: `dm_hive_inputs.consume_kind` is `['context', 'context', None]`. It expects two rows; a third input row is never consumed.

### Expected

- (1) The fixture classifies Beebou calls by more than one system-prompt phrase, or counts only Bee stream calls.
- (2) Find out whether the resumed control's `cleanup_complete` is no longer set on this runtime path (a product bug), or the test's expectation is stale.
- (3) The test asserts the current registered version.
- (4) Find out what the third input row is; if it is a new kind of input, the test checks it explicitly.

### Done when

All four pass with `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1` on HK, and (1) passes 10 runs in a row.

Found by #1675 / PR #1825, under #1665.

### 🚀 Background Description

来源：2026-11-17 群内讨论，胡犇提出——「现网捞日志统计性能那个看板，可以把日志捞出来把这个缓存命中率也算下」。雷辉在群里要求按此建议提一条 issue。

背景上下文（同一讨论）：

- 龙建宇反馈，最新 profile 下（Beebou 自研 harness 对 context 控制较好）缓存命中率表现「还行」，解释是「本质就是别乱压缩，整块切掉整块拿回这样」，并提到 bees / WorkSwarm 这条链路可能还有优化空间，「具体的效果等后面 memory 复杂度上来了可能得持续监控」。
- 刘红升提出「这个需要有独立的测试看护」，并说明意图识别是后续最重要的一环。
- 既有的命中率问题已有单点记录：#884（偶现前缀缓存异常失效，单次命中率 0.22%，已 closed），说明单次异常会被整体比例放大，需要持续、可复现的口径观察。

需求要点：在**现网**维度（不是离线 profile）把模型前缀缓存命中率纳入已有性能看板，数据来自现网日志。

### Design Ideas

1. 数据来源：现网服务日志（云侧）+ 端侧/网关已有耗时日志，不新增对用户内容的采集；只统计 token 计数类字段（输入 tokens、命中缓存 tokens、未命中 tokens）。
2. 指标口径：
   - 单次命中率 = 命中 tokens / 输入 tokens；
   - 会话级累计命中率；
   - 全局按时间窗口（可按小时/天）的命中率与样本量；
   - 命中率分布（P50 / P95）与「整段未命中」（hit ≈ 0）请求占比、次数。
3. 明确分母与缺失处理：缺失字段不按 0 计入，单独标记为样本缺失，避免把缺失当成低命中率。
4. 维度拆分：至少按 harness / 执行链路（Beebou、bees / WorkSwarm 等）、模型名、以及是否新会话区分，便于定位是哪一层在压缩上下文。
5. 与既有指标口径对齐：#972 的端到端性能观测、以及 metrics 整合工作的字段定义，避免重复造一套口径；如字段不足，需先补采集再做看板。

### Involved Public APIs

待确认：需要现网日志或云侧指标里是否已暴露 cached tokens 字段；若只有部分链路记录（例如仅 Beebou harness 侧），需先明确各链路的采集覆盖率，再决定看板展示还是先补采集。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 性能观测与看板：#972、metrics 相关整合工作。
- 上下文压缩 / 记忆策略：Beebou harness、bees / WorkSwarm，命中率变化是其效果的直接观测面。
- 既有命中率缺陷：#884。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 口径自检：用可控的样本日志（含正常命中、整段未命中、字段缺失、空会话）验证各指标计算与缺失标记正确。
2. 交叉核对：抽一段时间现网日志，人工按明细重算命中率，与看板结果一致。
3. 覆盖度核对：确认各执行链路/模型在样本中的占比，避免某一链路几乎无数据却被算成全局结论。
4. 告警/看护：命中率出现「整段未命中」突增时可被发现；对应「独立测试看护」的需求需与现有性能回归用例衔接。

### Additional Information

- 本条只要求「把命中率纳入现网性能看板并可追溯口径」，不预设优化方案；优化动作按定位结果另开 issue。
- 首次上线建议先出一版口径与样本说明，再谈基线和目标值。

1831.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1831.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

来源：2026-11-17 群内讨论。刘红升在讨论缓存命中率时明确提出「这个需要有独立的测试看护」；雷辉在群里确认按此口径拆出一条独立子项。

关联：#1830（现网性能看板增加模型前缀缓存命中率，已提），本条是其测试看护侧的子项，只做“可回归、可发现异常”，不重复看板口径定义。

背景上下文（同一讨论）：

- 龙建宇：最新 profile 下命中率表现「还行」，原因是 Beebou 自研 harness 对 context 控制较好，「本质就是别乱压缩，整块切掉整块拿回」；bees / WorkSwarm 这条链路还有优化空间。
- 龙建宇：具体效果等 memory 复杂度上来后「可能得持续监控」。
- 刘红升：这个需要有独立的测试看护。
- 既有单点缺陷 #884：偶现前缀缓存整段失效（单次命中率 0.22%），已 closed；说明单次异常会被整体比例放大，需要能持续发现这类「整段未命中」。

### Design Ideas

1. 用例输入可控：用固定的样本请求序列（正常延续、前缀不变、冷启动、整段未命中）驱动，断言各次请求的命中 tokens / 输入 tokens 关系，而不是只看会话合计。
2. 覆盖四类反例：
   - 前缀不变且短时间内再次请求 → 命中率不应掉到接近 0（#884 场景）；
   - 冷启动 / 新增大量上下文 → 允许低命中，标记为预期；
   - 字段缺失 → 单独标记样本缺失，不按 0 计入；
   - 压缩前后 → 压缩策略变更导致的命中率变化应可归因到具体链路。
3. 链路维度：至少覆盖 Beebou harness 与 bees / WorkSwarm 两条链路，分开断言，避免一条链路的低命中被另一条平均掉。
4. 与 #1830 看板的关系：看板负责现网观测与口径追溯，本条负责回归门禁与阈值看护；两者共用同一份指标定义，避免两套算法。
5. 阈值旁路：先采基线，再定阈值；阈值未定时先做「整段未命中次数突增」的看护，不预设目标命中率。

### Involved Public APIs

待确认：现有日志/指标里 cached tokens 字段的暴露范围，以及测试能否在受控环境复现「前缀不变但整段未命中」。若只能部分链路复现，需先明确各链路覆盖率再定用例范围。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- 看板与口径：#1830（本条的父项）、#972。
- 上下文压缩 / 记忆策略：Beebou harness、bees / WorkSwarm。
- 既有缺陷：#884（整段未命中，已 closed，但需回归看护防止复发）。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 分组用例：正常延续 / 冷启动 / 整段未命中 / 字段缺失 / 压缩前后，各自可独立判定，不用合计命中率掩盖单次异常。
2. 断言方式：既断言单次命中率，也断言「整段未命中」次数与占比，二者分开计。
3. 可重复性：固定样本序列与固定模型/工具响应时，结果应稳定；不稳定项需标注为跟踪而非门禁。
4. 与现网联动：看板上的异常可在测试集里找到对应用例（同一口径、同一字段）。
5. 输出：给出基线值、样本量、以及「异常突增能否被发现」的验证记录；不预设通过阈值。

### Additional Information

- 本条只要求「独立测试看护」，不预设优化动作；优化按定位结果另开 issue。
- 首次落地建议先出一版用例清单和基线，再谈阈值与门禁强度。

1832.body:
Follow-up to #1655 (orphan recovery). On a real ADX-like deployment the Bee-only runtime exits about two seconds into its **first** Bee run, and from that moment the Run can never be settled: `verify_orphan` refuses before it could ever compare the recorded runtime pid, so the Run stays `RUNNING` forever.

## Environment

- Image `sha256:1672a3b3296298e90d9058f138d474d15d342db78f29072017b25416f0620f33`, tag/source `927aca446d84ded7aaf47a876a31466a4845dcf` (main `26790238f9` + 85).
- Deployment env matches `deploy/digitalmate-template.prod.json` on the Hive keys: `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_RESULTS/TURNS/BEES=true`, `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_BEEBOU_ID=bench-gaia`, `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_CONFIG` TOML with `[hive.home] principal_binding="per_user"`; `bee_effects` stays off. Gateway client auth. Single replica, fresh workspace.
- Startup line: `hive_settings` shows `bees={"value":true,"source":"config"}`, `bee_effects={...,"value":false,"source":"default"}`.

## Steps

1. Open one WebSocket to `/digitalmate/ws` and send
   `{"method":"hive.message.send","params":{"message_id":"<uuid>","text":"Delegate this: create a Bee (worker template, focus: finance research) and dispatch this task to it — find NVIDIA's total revenue for fiscal year 2024 from its 10-K filing, then report the Bee's answer back to me."}}`
2. The response is `{"ok":true,"result":{"status":"committed","task_refs":["task_fe94b05ed6904a2292910cacd8ceb365"],"answer":"Done — I created a Bee … dispatched the task. It's queued, not yet started. …"}}` — so `create_bee` + `dispatch` did succeed.

## Observed

- `dm_hive_tasks`: `task_fe94b05ed6904a2292910cacd8ceb365`, `bee_id=bee-2d82fcfaa6a4ece81f546521816bb807`, `state=running`.
- `dm_hive_runs`: `run_2a14e6fd68f447deb4f471fcca69ea83` `state=RUNNING`, `ended_at_ms=None` — still RUNNING 20+ min later.
- `dm_hive_bee_contexts` = 0, `dm_hive_user_results` = 0, `dm_hive_stopped_results` = 0, `dm_hive_failed_results` = 0.
- Bee runtime `process.log` (`/data/state/bee-workswarm/process.log`), the turn's start is ~05:10:19Z:
  ```
  05:10:20.683 WARNING … reconcile add 'digitalmate-search' failed: [110512] mcp server add failed,
    server_config=server_name='digitalmate-search' params={'command':'/opt/bot/bin/python',
    'args':['-m','server_engine.search_mcp'], …}
    error='MCP server 'digitalmate-search' connect/register cancelled (anyio task-group teardown): '
  05:10:21.484 INFO … interrupt: 已取消 1 个 TaskScheduler 运行中的任务   (×2)
  05:10:21.486 INFO … cleanup: 清理资源
  05:10:21     … checkpoint_save … reason=agent_finished
  05:10:21     … Cancelled task f5559d29221344acbbc6f9b28da6d461 successfully
  05:10:21     … TaskScheduler stopped
  05:10:21.620 INFO jiuwenswarm.server.agent_ws_server: [AgentWebSocketServer] 已停止
  05:10:21.620 INFO jiuwenswarm.common.utils: [AgentServer] stopped
  ```
  plus one un-retrieved `RuntimeError('Attempted to exit cancel scope in a different task than it was entered in')` in the same window.
- Ports inside the pod: `19000/19001/19002` (Personal Agent runtime) open; **`19100/19101/19102` (Bee-only runtime) closed**.
- Host log, one line at the failure and then once per reconcile pass:
  ```
  Bee execution requires reconciliation
  Bee run run_2a14e6fd… (task task_fe94b05…, turn run) is orphaned but has no isolation witness:
  the adapter is not the owned, ready, ask-only Bee runtime; it stays RUNNING
  ```

## Why it cannot settle (code)

`temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_verifier.py:129`:

```python
async def _orphan_witness(self, scope, task, claim, turn):
    record = await self._repository.hive_busy.read_bee_run_runtime(...)
    if record is None: return None, "the Store recorded no runtime instance for the Run's entry"
    if not self._owned_runtime(): return None, "the adapter is not the owned, ready, ask-only Bee runtime"
    current = self._execution.runtime_instance()
    ...
```

and `_owned_runtime()` (line 194) requires `adapter.ready is True` **and** `child.returncode is None`. Once the owned child process has exited, `ready` is False, so the `record.runtime_instance != current[0]` "the recorded process is gone" branch — the one written exactly for this case — is unreachable. #1655's recovery therefore never produces a terminal for a runtime that died, which is the more likely orphan than a restart.

`server_engine/hive_bee_scheduler.py:80` also hides the original cause:

```python
results = await asyncio.gather(*(run_bee(card) for card, _ in roster.active), return_exceptions=True)
for result in results:
    if isinstance(result, BaseException):
        logging.getLogger(__name__).warning('Bee execution requires reconciliation')
```

The exception raised by `run_bee` is swallowed with no type, message or traceback, so the deployment cannot tell what killed the run.

## Questions

1. Is the `run_bee` exception being dropped at `hive_bee_scheduler.py:80` intended? Logging the exception (repr + traceback) would already answer what happened here.
2. When the owned Bee runtime process exits mid-run, what is the intended path to a terminal? As written, `verify_orphan` cannot provide a witness (`_owned_runtime()` fails first). Should the "recorded runtime process is gone" branch be reachable without a ready adapter?
3. Is the `digitalmate-search` MCP registration failure (`connect/register cancelled (anyio task-group teardown)`) a symptom of that teardown or its cause? We could not separate them, because the launcher's own exception is swallowed (question 1).

## Not part of this report

Knowledge questions (e.g. "What is 2+2?", "what was NVIDIA's FY2024 revenue") are answered from the model's memory with `task_refs=[]` and no tools — Beebou only creates and dispatches a Bee when the text explicitly says to delegate. That may well be intended for a Home with no read-only provider registered (`ReadOnlyCatalog` starts empty, `quick_reply.toml` lists only `weather`); it is recorded here only so the run above is reproducible.

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供环境信息、原文与截图。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**本条记录的是用户在 Home 提出一个新问题后收到处理失败提示，不是“模型输出未校验”。** 根据报告者纠正，原描述误把同屏上一轮 NBA 回复中的可信度提醒当成了本次问题，现调整问题范围；具体失败原因待排查。

2026-11-17 02:35，移动端 Home，用户提问：

> 搜一下南京大学在重庆的历年分数线

随后返回：

> 抱歉，这条消息没能处理完成，其中一个操作可能已经执行。请先查看结果，再决定是否重试。

**已知现象与待查边界**

- 本次提问没有获得正常答复，而是收到上述失败提示。
- 提示要求“先查看结果”，但现有报告未提供可查的操作/任务入口或关联标识。
- “其中一个操作可能已经执行”只是界面提示，不能据此断定实际发生了外部操作，也不能判定失败来自模型输出校验、搜索能力、工具执行、提交或回执环节。

1839.author: Jianyu010
1839.body:
## 背景

#1749 / #1787 接入 Bee 工具后，`install_skill`、`uninstall_skill`、`search_skill` 仍保持关闭，作为已知阻塞。本 Issue 跟踪其解除条件。上级收集：#1665。

## 证据

- 同一用户的所有 Bee 共用一个 WorkSwarm 进程和 home：`<workspace>/bee-workswarm`（`workswarm_adapter.py`，`runtime_home`）。
- WorkSwarm `SkillManager` 和 SkillTool 列表是进程级的；运行时不知道某个 Session 服务的是哪只 Bee。因此装进去的技能对该用户所有 Bee 可见，违反 #1749 "Bee 私有技能作用域"。
- 只开 `search_skill` 会去在线技能市场搜索，却无处安装，没有意义。
- 记录位置：#1787 合入评论（PR #1803，`c6b0ae16f`），设计稿 `docs/implementations/contracts/hive-tool-access-1749.md` §4。

## 解除方式（二选一）

1. WorkSwarm 内按 Session 建 SkillManager / 技能列表，安装目标为 Bee 私有目录；或
2. Bee 迁出 WorkSwarm，改用 DM 自有 harness（v3.1 最终方向），技能由 `dm_hive_tools` 按 Bee 作用域管理。

倾向第 2 种，不在 WorkSwarm 内做一次性改造。无论哪种：内置技能不可卸载；安装技能不扩大工具授权或凭据。

## 完成标准

- [ ] 安装目标为 Bee 私有，另一只 Bee 不可见；卸载内置技能被拒。
- [ ] 新技能尝试禁用能力（旧 memory / cron / web_search）被拒。
- [ ] 设备端到端证据（#1790 口径）。
1839.title: [Feature][#1749 follow-up] Bee 技能市场工具（install/uninstall/search_skill）按 Bee 作用域开放

1840.author: Jianyu010
1840.body:
## 背景

#1786（PR #1800）开放了 Bee 的 `bash`。契约 §3 已写明：共享容器没有 OS 级隔离，因此 `bash` 的验收状态是"已开放，隔离未证明"。本 Issue 跟踪真正的隔离。上级收集：#1665。

## 证据

- `bash` 以 Host 同一 uid 在共享容器内运行。已有缓解：cwd 为 task 工作区、清空凭据类环境变量、超时、输出上限、journal。
- 仍可 `cd ../..` 访问其他 task 目录，以及 Host 的操作回执 `<workspace>/<tasks_dir>/<receipts_dir>/`，从而读取或伪造幂等回执。
- 也能在磁盘上碰到 WorkSwarm 旧 memory / cron 文件。工具层面它们被禁止，但文件层面没有隔离。
- 网络出口没有按任务授权限制。
- 记录位置：设计稿 §3 已知残余风险，#1800 矩阵中 `bash` 一行，#1790 阻塞 B1。

## 方向

- 至少：让 Host 私有状态（回执、Store、其他 task）对 `bash` 进程不可达，例如独立 uid 加目录权限，或回执移到 `bash` 无权访问的位置。
- 目标：每个 task 的执行沙箱，例如 jiuwenbox 或容器内的 namespace / seccomp 隔离，并限制网络出口。注意 #1228 / #1316 不要求每只 Bee 一个沙箱，但"共享文件系统不等于授权"仍需要强制手段。

## 完成标准

- [ ] 负例：跨 task 读写、读取或伪造回执、读取凭据、未授权出网均失败，且由 OS 机制强制，而不是靠字符串检查。
- [ ] #1790 矩阵中 `bash` 一行由"隔离未证明"改为"已验证"。
1840.title: [Feature][#1749 follow-up] Bee bash 执行隔离（共享容器、回执可达、出网）

1841.author: Jianyu010
1841.body:
## 背景

#1783（PR #1797）让 Beebou 经 Plugin Gateway 调用 `agentcore-tools` 读类工具。Bee 路径的读调用由 Host gate 在准入前后各复核一次 live Run / 绑定（含 Store 侧持久绑定）；Beebou 读入口目前只校验 Gateway 的封存身份和 task 工作区，没有 Store 侧复核。上级收集：#1665。

## 证据

- #1783 合入评论的"残余项"："Beebou read entry has no Store fence (read class only)"。
- 风险较低：只读，且身份由 Host 从已绑定的 (scope, session_ref) 签发；但与 Bee 路径不一致，Beebou 会话被撤权或换绑后的窗口内仍可读。

## 完成标准

- [ ] Beebou 读调用在执行前和结果披露前，复核 Session Store 中该 Beebou 会话的当前绑定与撤权状态。
- [ ] 测试：会话撤权、换绑、Stop 后，同一回合内的读调用被拒，且不回显内容。
1841.title: [Feature][#1749 follow-up] Beebou 读工具入口补 Store 侧绑定 / 撤权复核

1842.author: huben0423-hw
1842.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

用户面对的是一个完整的对话助手。**Beebou 自身能力与它可通过 Bee 委派完成的能力，共同组成助手对用户提供的能力。** 用户不需要先理解 Beebou/Bee 的内部角色分工，才能问清楚助手能做什么。

截图中用户问「你是否有向github提pr的功能」。Beebou 回答「没有。我没有向 GitHub 提交 PR 的功能」，随后以自身仅能调度/管理 Bee、没有 git/gh 工具为理由解释，并引导用户自己在本地或 GitHub 网页/CLI 操作、由它提供文案。

**本单关注能力回答的主体与口径，不报告“GitHub 操作能力一定不存在”，也不要求新增 GitHub 工具。** 当 Beebou 自己不能直接执行、但当前获授权的 Bee 可以完成时，不应把前者回答成“整个助手不能做”。截图还包含对 Bee 不能访问仓库的断言，其真实性未由工具/权限回执验证；这里不把模型自述当成实际能力清单。

### Design Ideas

- 回答“你能做什么／能不能做 X”时，以完整助手为主体：汇总 Beebou 可直接完成及可委派给 Bee 完成的、当前实际可用且获授权的能力。
- 对用户使用任务语言，不要求用户先选择或理解内部角色。内部需要委派时，由 Beebou 协调；必要时说明处理方式，但不因主控自身工具较少而否认整体能力。
- 区分“现在能完成”“需要连接账号或授权后能完成”“当前确实不支持”“能力尚未核实”。未核实就先查现有工具/能力信息，不能凭自身工具列表替所有 Bee 下结论。
- 例如 GitHub PR 场景：只有实际具备获授权执行路径时才回答“可以帮你修改并提交 PR”；缺账号/仓库权限时说明具体前提。若整体确实没有此能力，明确说明并提供草稿等替代方式。
- 替代方案：继续逐角色枚举权限会把内部架构负担转嫁用户，不作为默认口径；仅修改提示词而不核对实际可执行能力，也无法保证声明可靠。具体实现沿用现有能力发现/授权机制，设计稿及接口归属在实施阶段评审。

### Involved Public APIs

本条不预设新增 API，也不扩大执行权限。复用实际工具目录、Bee 能力及 Host 授权事实；若现有查询不能支撑整体能力回答，将缺口交给 #1646 / #1761 对齐，不另造未经授权的能力清单。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

父收集：#1665。

查重范围：检索开放及关闭 issue 的 GitHub/PR、能力、Beebou/Bee 相关标题与正文，并核对以下相关项。未发现专门覆盖“以完整助手为主体对外说明能力”的同题 issue。

- #1761：执行前能力预检与统一事实来源；本单关注用户询问能力时的完整助手回答口径，不替代其接口设计。
- #1646：Bee 工具发现，为可委派能力提供依据。
- #1749 / #1786：工具及开发执行接入，属于实际能力建设；本单不要求新增 git/gh、GitHub 连接器或 PR 执行链。
- #971：跨会话忘记此前已成功提 issue 的操作方式；本截图未证明遗忘，不能直接视为重复。
- #1728 / #1129：避免承诺不存在的能力；本单同时避免低估已可委派的能力，不要求无条件宣称能做。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. Beebou 无直接 GitHub 工具，但一个当前获授权的 Bee 具备提交 PR 能力：用户问“你能提 PR 吗”，应按整体助手回答可完成，不能仅以主控无工具为由否认。
2. 仅 Beebou 具备某项能力、仅 Bee 具备某项能力、两者均具备三组，回答均覆盖完整助手真实可用的任务能力。
3. 工具存在但账号未连接/仓库未授权，明确前提；撤权、工具不可用及所有 Bee 均不支持时不得承诺可执行。
4. 用户不知道 Bee 的存在时，能够直接询问并提出任务，不被要求自行理解内部角色分工。
5. 使用“你”“这个助手”“你们能做什么”等问法，能力说明保持一致；跨轮次/重启后不能复用已失效授权来回答。
6. 能力询问本身不触发 push/创建 PR 等写操作；用户后续授权执行时，按原有 Host 执行和回执规则处理。
7. 记录能力清单、授权状态、模型实际回答及必要的真实委派结果。上述是待执行验收计划，本次未运行测试。

### Additional Information

- 用户明确补充：不是在报告“无法操作 GitHub”；是 Beebou 只按自己的能力回答，而用户感知的是一个统一助手，Bee 的可用能力也应告诉用户。
- 来源：移动端 Beebou Home 截图，中文界面，状态栏 02:36；具体截图日期、时区未确认。
- App build、系统/设备版本、服务端部署 SHA、账号连接与实际工具授权未采集，不以本地 main 代替现场版本。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![用户询问 GitHub PR 能力，Beebou 按自身调度角色回答](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-evidence-unified-capabilities-20261117/issues/assets/2026-11-17-unified-assistant-capabilities.png?raw=true)
1842.title: [Feature]: Beebou 应以整体助手口径说明自身与可委派 Bee 的可用能力

1845.author: Jianyu010
1845.body:
Part of #1665.

## Symptom

In the live Hive choice-card eval (`tests/eval/hive-live`, `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01/02/03`, product model, `local_cli`), Beebou often answers a multi-step setup request itself instead of creating a Bee. The case expects `new:spawn`. When Beebou answers instead, there is no Bee task to follow up on, so every later turn of that repeat is ungraded.

| Run | Head | Setup done inline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1817-b7bf2e96` | b7bf2e96 | 3 of 9 repeats (01 r2, 02 r1, 03 r3) |
| `1817-e997cc1f` | e997cc1f (main merged, incl. #1788) | 5 of 9 repeats (01 r1, 02 r1–r3, 03 r1) |

The #1810 run showed the same pattern.

Example, `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-02` r1 T1: "Make a grocery list for a Sunday barbecue for 10 people: group it by meat, vegetables, drinks and condiments, give a quantity and an estimated price for each item, and total the budget." Beebou made one model call, used no tools, and wrote the whole list in its reply. No quick reply was involved.

Artifacts are kept locally under `hive-live-artifacts/1817-e997cc1f/` and `1817-b7bf2e96/` (trace.json and server.log per repeat).

## Questions to settle

1. Is the rise from 3/9 to 5/9 a regression? The only change on this path between the two heads is the main merge, which added `global_memory_read` to the `dispatch` schema (#1788). Nine repeats can't tell. A setup-only A/B (main against main without #1788's schema change, same cases, same model) settles it.
2. What is the rule? Beebou's prompt decides when to delegate to a Bee and when to answer directly. Decide whether multi-step work like this (structured, several parts, totals) should always go to a Bee, and make the rule and the eval agree:
   - If such work belongs to a Bee, the Beebou delegation guidance (prompt text in config, not code) should say so clearly enough that the product model follows it reliably.
   - If answering directly is acceptable product behaviour, the eval cases need setups that clearly need a Bee, or accept `answer` and seed the Bee tasks another way, so the choice-card turns are still reached.

## Done when

- The cause is stated with evidence: A/B result, prompt diff if any.
- The fix is merged. Either the delegation rule makes the product model create Bees for these setups, or the eval setups are made deterministic, with the reasoning written down.
- A live rerun of `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-01/02/03` × 3 reaches the probe turns in at least as many repeats as the better of the two runs above, and has no new regression in the clear and ambiguous follow-ups.
1845.title: Hive: Beebou answers multi-step setup requests itself instead of creating a Bee (live choice-card eval)

1847.author: Jianyu010
1847.body:
Part of #1665.

## Symptom

Beebou told the user that a Bee's result had not been passed on yet, when it already had been.

Live Hive eval `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-03` r2, run `1817-e997cc1f` (product model, `local_cli`):

1. T1: the user asks for a birthday-party shopping list. Beebou dispatches it to a new Bee.
2. T2 (sent at about ms 1794896071): the user asks for a five-day packing schedule for a move.
   - The **quick reply** (frame `phase: quick`; in the final phases it is recorded as `displayed: false`) adds: "另外，之前那份生日会采购清单的任务助手好像有结果回来了，我稍后一并整理给你。"
   - At about 1794896074 a `hive.beebou.reply` frame arrives with `trigger: bee_done`, `outcome: committed`, `source_seq: 3`. This is Beebou's committed relay of the birthday result to the user.
   - At about 1794896088 the **normal turn** dispatches the moving schedule correctly, then adds: "另外更正一点上一条回复：生日会采购清单的结果我还没有转给你，那份任务助手已经完成，你随时可以要". That is false: the result was relayed at seq 3, about 14 s earlier.

The grader also flagged the turn (`live_normal_no_false_done` on "那份任务助手已经完成"). That flag is a false positive about the wrong task. The real defect is the false "not sent" claim, and the "correction" of a quick reply that the user, per `displayed: false`, may never have seen.

Artifacts are kept locally under `hive-live-artifacts/1817-e997cc1f/HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-03/r2/` (`trace.json`, `server.log`).

## Questions to settle

1. **What did the T2 normal turn see?** Did its context include the seq 3 `bee_done` relay? It was committed while T2 was running, which suggests a stale-context or ordering race. Did `list_bees` `results[]` still list the birthday task as unreported? Did `finished[]` (#1817) show it, and does `finished[]` need a reported flag so the model can tell "reported" from "not yet reported"?
2. **Why did the normal turn "correct" the quick reply?** Was the quick reply in its context even though it was not displayed? If a quick reply that was not displayed is still fed to the normal turn as said, the normal turn should not correct what the user never saw.
3. **Grader:** `live_normal_no_false_done` should only judge the task dispatched in that turn. It currently flags a true statement about another, already finished task (also seen in 01 r1 P4 and 03 r1 P4 of run `1817-b7bf2e96`).

## Done when

- The cause is stated with evidence from the trace and Store rows.
- Beebou does not claim a delivered result is undelivered:
  - If the turn's view was stale, the Host or Store gives the normal turn an accurate delivered/undelivered view.
  - If the problem is model wording, the prompt text in config says how to treat results already relayed.
- A regression test covers it.
- The grader rule is fixed to judge only the turn's own task.
- A live rerun shows no false "not sent" or "corrected" claim, and no regression in the choice-card cases.
1847.title: Hive: Beebou says a relayed Bee result was not sent and "corrects" its quick reply

1850.body:
## 问题描述
用户已经通过自然语言明确要求在手机日历中新增事项，并提供了事项名称和开始时间，APP 仍展示“是否添加”的人工确认卡片，要求再次选择“添加到本机日历”，交互重复，增加操作步骤。

## 复现步骤
1. 在 Digital Mate 对话页面输入：`在日历中增加今天晚上八点事项，事项名:吃多维`。
2. 查看 APP 返回的卡片。

## 实际结果
根据用户提供的真机截图，APP 显示“Beebou 想问你”卡片：
- 提问：“要添加「吃多维」到今天20:00到手机日历吗？”
- 事项：吃多维。
- 时间：2026-11-17 20:00–20:30。
- 按钮：“不添加”和“添加到本机日历”。
用户已明确表达新增意图，但仍需再次点击添加才能继续。

## 期望与建议
- 在用户明确要求新增日历事项、必要参数齐全且已有相应权限的情况下，评估直接执行并返回创建结果，减少重复确认。
- 如果缺少必要参数，只询问缺失信息；例如用户仅指定开始时间，结束时间是否可以使用明确的默认时长，需要统一产品规则，避免将参数补全与重复确认混为一谈。
- 若因日历写入授权或产品安全规则必须确认，应说明原因，并区分首次授权与每次业务确认，明确此场景的交互规则。
- 保留创建结果反馈和失败提示，避免未创建成功却提示完成。

## 验收建议
1. 已授权、明确新增意图、参数齐全：按确定后的规则处理，避免无理由重复确认。
2. 缺少事项名称、日期或时间：仅澄清必要参数。
3. 未授权或权限被拒绝：准确引导授权，不误报创建成功。
4. 如允许直接创建，验证只创建一次，返回名称、日期和时间与用户要求一致。

## 环境与依据
- 鸿蒙手机真机，反馈日期：2026-11-17。
- 依据用户提供的截图和操作说明；截图未显示 APP 版本。
- 本 issue 为交互优化反馈，确认卡片是否属于必须的授权/确认步骤需结合产品规则进一步评估，尚未进行代码根因分析。
1850.title: [体验优化] 用户明确要求新增日历事项后仍弹出二次确认卡片，建议减少重复操作

1852.author: hlXia-mm
1852.body:
## 问题描述
用户明确要求删除本地日历中的指定事项后，APP 没有自动查找匹配日程，而是先弹出选项卡，要求点击“读取本机日历”，增加一次面向内部处理步骤的操作。

## 复现步骤
1. 本地日历存在今天的“吃多维”事项（截图上文显示此前已添加今天20:00事项）。
2. 输入：`本地日历中，删除今天的吃多维事项`。
3. 查看返回卡片。

## 实际结果（用户真机截图）
卡片显示：
- “选择要删除的「吃多维」事项（今天）”。
- “本机日历”。
- “先读取本机日历，再选择要操作的日程。”
- 两个按钮：“读取本机日历”“暂不操作”。
用户已经明确表达删除目标，却仍需主动触发读取流程；卡片此时也未展示真实匹配到的日程。

## 改进建议
在用户已授予日历权限的前提下，系统应自动完成查找，无需用户点击“读取本机日历”。按查询结果决定后续交互：
1. 唯一匹配：结合产品规则及删除是否可撤销决定直接删除并提供撤销，或仅保留一次展示明确事项与时间的最终删除确认；不重复询问是否开始读取。
2. 多条匹配：展示真实候选项的名称、时间等信息，要求用户消歧，避免误删。
3. 无匹配：明确提示未找到，不展示空泛选择卡。
4. 未授权：使用必要的系统授权流程；权限失败时说明原因。
5. 重复日程：需要明确本次事件或整个系列，避免扩大删除范围。

## 业界规范参考与适用边界
Apple Human Interface Guidelines 的 Alerts 指南建议，对常见且可撤销的操作减少打断；对不可撤销的破坏性操作应保留必要确认。
参考：https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts
据此提出本产品建议：去掉要求用户手动触发“读取”的中间卡片；消歧、权限授权及必要的删除确认应按实际情况保留。此为参考设计原则后的建议，不代表已验证其他助手在本场景下的具体实现。

## 验收方式
- 已授权且存在匹配日程时，无需点击“读取本机日历”即可完成查询并进入相应处理。
- 唯一、多条、无匹配均有准确反馈，不误删其他事项。
- 确认保留时展示真实目标及删除范围，取消后不删除。
- 权限拒绝、查询失败、删除失败不误报成功；成功后实际日历与反馈一致，重复触发不造成重复操作。

## 环境与关联
- 鸿蒙手机真机；反馈日期：2026-11-17，截图未展示 APP 版本。
- 依据用户截图及操作说明，尚未开展代码根因分析。
- 相关新增日程交互反馈：#1850。本 issue 单独跟踪删除场景。
1852.title: [体验优化] 明确要求删除本地日历事项后仍需点击读取卡片，建议自动查找并减少中间操作

1853.author: hlXia-mm
1853.body:
## 问题描述
用户明确要求删除今天指定的本地日历事项，APP 展示“读取本机日历”卡片；点击后却提示“无法确定操作或日期范围，请重新提出请求”，删除流程无法继续。
此场景包含两个问题：
1. 交互冗余：已明确指定删除操作、今天及事项名称，仍要求用户手动触发读取日历。该项已由 #1852 跟踪。
2. 功能故障：用户按卡片指引点击读取后，系统无法继续处理已有请求。本 issue 重点跟踪此失败。

## 复现步骤
1. 在本地日历中新增今天的“吃多维”事项；截图上文显示此前已添加今天20:00的事项。
2. 在 Digital Mate 中输入：`本地日历中，删除今天的吃多维事项`。
3. APP 展示“选择要删除的「吃多维」事项（今天）”卡片，按钮为“读取本机日历”“暂不操作”。
4. 点击“读取本机日历”。

## 实际结果
卡片内出现错误：`无法确定操作或日期范围，请重新提出请求。`
“读取本机日历”“暂不操作”按钮仍显示，未进入候选日程选择或删除流程。原请求和卡片标题已经包含删除操作、日期“今天”及事项名称，却仍要求用户重新提出请求。

## 预期结果
- 点击读取时，应使用原请求中已明确的删除意图、事项名称与日期范围，正确查找本地日程并继续处理。
- 已授权时，优先自动查找，减少“读取”中间卡片；具体交互优化见 #1852。
- 唯一匹配按产品删除确认规则处理；多条匹配展示真实候选项；无匹配明确提示未找到。
- 缺少参数时只澄清实际缺失项，不丢失已提供的信息；权限拒绝、读取失败等应给出对应原因。

## 验收建议
1. 完整复现上述输入和点击流程，不再出现“无法确定操作或日期范围”。
2. 正确解析“今天”的本地日期范围并保留删除意图、事项名称。
3. 覆盖唯一匹配、多条同名、无匹配、权限拒绝与读取失败；不误删其他日程，不误报成功。
4. 重复点击不产生重复删除；取消操作不删除。

## 环境与证据
- 鸿蒙手机真机；反馈日期：2026-11-17；截图未显示 APP 版本。
- 根据用户提供的15:05真机截图与操作说明记录，尚未采集日志或分析代码，具体根因待定位。
- 相关交互问题：#1852；新增日程重复确认问题：#1850。
1853.title: [Bug] 删除指定本地日历事项时，点击读取本机日历提示无法确定操作或日期范围

1854.author: hlXia-mm
1854.body:
## 问题描述
用户要求删除今天本地日历中的“吃多维”事项，且反馈该事项唯一，APP 却展示日程选择卡片，并混入与目标无关的“进展会”。候选列表未正确限定用户指定的事项，既增加操作，也存在误选、误删其他日程的风险。

## 复现条件与步骤
1. 本地日历今天存在唯一一条“吃多维”，时间为20:00–20:30，同时存在其他不同名称的日程，例如“进展会”17:00–17:30。
2. 在对话页输入：`本地日历中，删除今天的吃多维事项`。
3. 进入日程选择卡片，检查候选项。

## 实际结果（用户真机截图）
卡片标题为“选择今天要删除的‘吃多维’事项”，说明为“请选择要操作的本机日程”，却显示两个候选：
- 进展会：2026-11-17 17:00–17:30，UTC+08:00，Phone。
- 吃多维：2026-11-17 20:00–20:30，UTC+08:00，Phone。
其中“进展会”与删除目标不相关；用户反馈“吃多维”当天仅一条，不存在需要从多条同名事项中选择的歧义。

## 预期结果
- 查找结果应按请求的日期范围、事项名称及其他已明确条件匹配，不将同一天所有日程直接作为删除候选。
- 唯一匹配时，无需再展示候选选择卡；进入产品规定的删除处理流程。若必须最终确认，应展示唯一目标及删除范围，不能要求在无关日程间选择。
- 多条真实匹配时，才展示候选，使用时间等信息供用户区分。
- 无匹配时明确提示未找到，不使用无关事项凑候选。
- 删除时确保目标标识与所匹配/确认的日程一致，避免误删。

## 验收方式
1. 今天存在“进展会”和唯一“吃多维”：仅匹配“吃多维”，不展示多候选卡；操作后“进展会”保持不变。
2. 今天有多条“吃多维”：仅展示符合条件的候选，并可按时间区分。
3. “吃多维”只存在于其他日期：不匹配其他日期，不删除无关事项。
4. 无匹配、取消、权限拒绝或查询失败时不删除，不误报成功。
5. 对重复日程明确本次/系列范围，不扩大用户指定范围。

## 环境与关联
- 鸿蒙手机真机，反馈日期2026-11-17，截图时间15:06；截图未展示 APP 版本。
- 本 issue 根据用户截图及唯一性反馈记录，尚未进行日志或代码根因分析。
- #1852 跟踪读取卡片的冗余操作；#1853 跟踪读取卡片点击失败。本 issue 跟踪候选匹配错误与唯一匹配仍要求选择的问题。
1854.title: [Bug] 删除唯一的本地日历事项时仍显示选择卡片，候选混入无关日程

1856.author: hlXia-mm
1856.body:
## 问题描述
用户在“本地能力连接”页面已看到定位“已授权”，输入“查看附近美食”后仍弹出位置授权窗口，感觉重复、增加操作。截图显示该窗口实际请求将“大致位置”升级为“精确位置”，因此需同时检查权限状态展示与精确定位请求策略，而不能直接认定为同一权限重复申请。

## 复现步骤
1. 已允许 APP 访问位置，打开“本地能力连接”，定位显示“已授权”（蓝色勾选）。
2. 返回对话页，输入：`查看附近美食`。
3. 观察位置授权弹框。

## 实际结果（用户提供的两张真机截图）
- 图一：“本地能力连接”页面定位显示“已授权”，没有区分大致位置/精确位置。
- 图二：系统弹框询问“允许‘DigitalMate’的位置权限从‘大致位置’改为‘精确位置’？”，说明用途为附近美食搜索、重新定位和系统地图导航，并提供“本次使用允许”“仅使用期间允许”“不允许”。
- 用户因此认为已授权后再次索要权限，操作冗余。

## 期望与改进建议
1. 权限页面准确区分未授权、大致位置已授权、精确位置已授权，避免笼统“已授权”与实际请求不一致。
2. 评估附近美食搜索对定位精度的真实需求；已有大致位置且足以搜索时优先利用现有授权，不无条件要求升级。
3. 确实需要精确位置时，应在适当时机说明原因并调用系统授权，不绕过系统授权要求。
4. 若用户已授予当前有效的精确位置权限，不重复申请；处理好一次性授权到期、权限撤销和系统定位开关关闭等情况。
5. 拒绝升级精确定位后，如能力允许，继续使用大致位置或提供手动选择区域，不将其直接等同于所有定位权限被拒绝。

## 验收建议
- 仅大致位置授权：状态展示准确，附近美食搜索按精度需求处理，不无理由强制升级。
- 精确位置授权有效：执行附近美食搜索不重复弹出相同授权请求。
- 拒绝升级、一次性权限失效、撤销权限、关闭定位服务：状态与反馈准确，不死循环弹窗，不误报定位成功。

## 环境与依据
鸿蒙手机真机；反馈日期2026-11-17；截图时间15:14；截图未显示 APP 版本。
依据用户操作说明与截图记录，尚未进行代码或日志根因分析。待核实当前已授权的具体精度以及搜索实现要求的精度。
1856.title: [体验优化] 定位显示已授权，查看附近美食仍请求升级精确位置，需优化权限展示与申请策略

1859.author: Jianyu010
1859.body:
Part of #1665.

## Symptom

Live Hive eval `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-03` P3: "时间往后推一天吧。" comes right after P2, a clear follow-up on the meeting agenda. Three tasks could fit P3, so Beebou should ask with a choice card. Instead it usually dispatches the change to the agenda Bee, the one the previous turn followed up on. The case rubric says "刚跟进过议程不等于指议程".

| Run | P3 outcome |
|---|---|
| `1847-f20c4c11` (PR #1855 head) | `new:reuse` to the agenda Bee in r1, r2 and r3 |
| `1817-e997cc1f` | r1 agenda edited inline; r2 `steer` to the agenda task; r3 card |
| `1817-b7bf2e96` | r1 `new:reuse`; r2 card; r3 agenda edited inline |

So 2 of 9 repeats asked. P1 ("那个再加一点。", with no preceding clear follow-up) gets a card with all three task_refs in 3 of 3 repeats of `1847-f20c4c11`. P3 had no quick reply in any of these repeats, so it is the normal turn's choice.

## Done when

- The cause is stated: the ambiguity rule or prompt (`AMBIGUITY_RULE`, `selection.py` / config), or the context recency.
- `HIVE-LIVE-CHOICE-03` P3 asks with a card that has task_refs in a live rerun, without regressing P2/P4 (clear follow-ups go to the right Bee).
1859.title: Hive: an ambiguous follow-up right after a clear one goes to the last-touched Bee instead of a choice card

1862.body:

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

用户已授予系统「全部日程」权限并启用应用内日历权限，在聊天里新增、编辑或删除本机日程时，仍可能遇到额外的添加确认或手动读取步骤。按标题删除时，相近标题也可能进入候选列表。

1. 在已授权的客户端发出能触发结构化日程新增提案的指令，观察新增前是否仍要求点击确认卡片。
2. 对已有日程发起编辑或按标题删除，观察是否仍需点击「读取本机日历」。再按与现有日程相近但不相同的标题发起删除，检查候选是否包含该日程。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

1. 使用合成日程复现。给明天新增「开会」或「练字」，发送「删除明天开会的日程」，再到系统日历核对。真机反馈称日程已删除，对话却显示「你取消了这次操作，日程仍保留在原处」。已有真机截图缺少同一条日程的删除前后记录。对话应区分已删除、未执行和待核对。
2. 在同一会话先问天气，再发送「查询明天的日程」，打开「实时活动 → 最近话题」。反馈截图中的标题仍包含「天气查询」和缺少城市的描述。该处应展示实际日程请求的标题。
3. 为目标日期和隔天各准备合成日程，发送「删除明天所有的日程」或「删除the day after tomorrow所有的日程」。出现过日历读取卡或让用户选择日程的步骤。云端应下发明确的单日批量操作，端侧在授权有效时直接执行。
4. 点名删除「明天锻炼的日程」时，等待确认期间会短暂闪现回执。读取、新增、修改和删除的日历回执卡均应隐藏，最终结果使用对话文字展示。

2026-11-17 15:29–15:38（UTC+08:00），HarmonyOS 真机 JUY-AL50，Beebou 对话与实时活动，本机系统日历，连接 20010。

DigitalMate 0.1.0（10006），初始反馈的安装包对应已合入的 #1780。

20010 模拟器的合成日程交易。截图仅截取点名删除请求和最终对话。

相关 #1852、#1853、#1854。天气相关文字来自托管会话标题，截图无法确认该轮执行了天气查询。

### Checklist

- [x] 已检索相关 Issue；#1212 涉及忙运行时释放和队列超时，但未覆盖本次 OOM 重启后 Task/turn/runtime 状态分裂。
- [ ] 最新版本是否已修复：尚未完成同版本镜像与受控沙箱复验。
- [x] 已提供环境、受控复现步骤与脱敏视觉证据；原始用户图片和聊天内容不上传仓库。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现网故障**：用户请求移除照片中的路灯。11 月 13 日执行时，沙箱达到 2 GiB 内存上限并被 OOM 杀掉；后续启动仅把旧 Task 改成 `waiting`，对应会话 turn 仍是 `RUNNING`，runtime 仍为 `occupied=1`。11 月 16 日同一会话的新请求因此保持 `QUEUED`，没有派发到 WorkSwarm 执行器，也没有修图工具调用。

**两段原因需要分别处理**：

1. **中断触发**：ADX 负责人确认该沙箱于 11 月 13 日 18:12:02（北京时间）退出，`OOMKilled=true`；内核记录内存使用量和限制值均为 `2097152 kB`。18:12:01 最后一步启动 PIL/NumPy 整图处理并分配多个图像数组。尚无法确认具体哪一次分配触发峰值。(OOM后不能自动重启问题已解决)
2. **持续排队的应用缺陷**：重启后的持久状态分裂。现场只读记录为旧 Task `status=waiting, cut_by=restart`，旧 turn `RUNNING`，同一 runtime `occupied=1`；新 Task `pending`、新 turn `QUEUED`、无 `session_id`、无执行事件。按现有队列领取条件，只要旧 turn 保留 `RUNNING`，新 turn 就不具备领取资格；只读反事实查询排除该旧记录后，资格条件恢复。残留的 `RUNNING` 是持久状态，**不代表原 P 图进程仍在运行**。

| 北京时间 | 现场事件 |
| --- | --- |
| 11/13 18:10:10 | 原 P 图请求开始执行；WorkSwarm trace 记录模型与工具步骤。 |
| 11/13 18:12:01 | 最后一步启动 PIL/NumPy 整图处理。 |
| 11/13 18:12:02 | ADX 负责人确认沙箱 OOM 退出，`OOMKilled=true`。从请求开始约 112 秒。 |
| 11/13 21:58 | 同一沙箱日志出现 Gateway/AgentServer 新的启动记录；旧 Task 后续被标记 `cut_by=restart`。 |
| 11/16 20:06:40 | 同一会话再次提交“移除路灯”请求，受理为 `QUEUED`。 |
| 11/17 15:14 | 只读复核仍为 `QUEUED`；旧 turn 仍 `RUNNING`，runtime 仍占用；新 turn 执行事件为 0。 |

**受控最小复现**（测试环境，勿在现网重放副作用）：启动一个同会话图像任务，在执行中让 2 GiB 沙箱触发 OOM；重启 Personal Agent 后读取 Task、`dm_session_turns`、`dm_session_runtimes`；再向同一会话提交普通消息。实际现场状态组合使新消息一直不能领取。测试须核对旧执行的未知结果，不得盲目重放图像写入。

**预期**：沙箱 OOM 后，旧任务及会话轮次、runtime 占用按同一恢复判定收口；未知外部效果先对账。下一条已受理消息能够执行，或在明确期限内得到可操作的失败/恢复结果，不无限停留在 `QUEUED`。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 环境：DigitalMate / Personal Agent 现网，WorkSwarm 执行器；北京时间（Asia/Shanghai）。
- 沙箱内存上限：2 GiB；ADX 负责人提供的内核使用量/限制值均为 `2097152 kB`。
- 现场索引：SFS 工作区 `digitalmate-w-5b43d654…`；原 Task `turn_a4724aab…`，新 Task `turn_cdf276c3…`，同一 conversation `conv_67ed023a…`。完整 ID 留在受控现场记录中，不在 Issue 搬运用户图片或原始日志。
- 核对方式：只读 SFS 日志、WorkSwarm span、SQLite（包含 WAL）与持久状态；没有重放任务或修改生产数据。
- 手机设备、系统和 App 构建号：本次没有可核实记录，待补。

### Version Information

- 事故 Personal Agent 镜像 digest、对应源码 SHA、ADX 沙箱版本及手机 App 构建号：待运维补充，当前不能把本地源码直接认定为事故镜像。
- 调查时本地仓库 revision：`118426eb6f497032ef41135e707e662409764c9f`，仅用于解释当前实现的恢复/队列机制，不作为现网部署版本证明。

### Screenshots / Recordings

下面是依据现场时间戳与状态重建的**脱敏诊断图，非原始客户端截图**；原始用户图片和聊天截图留在受控反馈渠道，不进入 Git。

![OOM 中断后 Task waiting、turn RUNNING、runtime occupied，导致新任务 QUEUED 的脱敏时间线](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-evidence/oom-session-recovery-20261113/.github/issue-assets/oom-session-recovery-20261113/timeline.svg?raw=true)

### Additional Information

**可能的修复归属与边界**：主责 A「会话与任务」（@huben0423-hw）；ADX 提供 OOM 及沙箱生命周期证据，图像处理 owner 协同评估内存峰值。应用恢复应在 Session/Store owner 内对齐 Task、turn 和 runtime 状态，并覆盖新提交、Retry、重启和未知执行结果；不要仅凭断开的 socket 清理占位，也不要把未确认的修图效果再次执行。

**验收建议**：

- 受控 OOM/进程终止后，旧任务、turn 和 runtime 的持久状态一致；无法证明外部结果时保留可见的待核对状态。
- 同一会话后续消息可继续执行，或在有界时间内得到明确失败及恢复入口；旧孤儿 `RUNNING` 不使它无限排队。
- 对原请求 ID、attempt、沙箱退出原因、恢复判定、队列阻塞原因和最终状态有可关联日志；不得把累计等待误报为模型或修图耗时。
- 核对是否需要限制 PIL/NumPy 同时存在的整图数组数量、峰值预算或分块处理；具体触发分配点须另行采样验证。

关联：#1212（已关闭，忙 runtime 与队列超时；活动前序轮次不计入超时）、#1062（已关闭，类似“仍在处理”症状但不同现场状态）。本 Issue 记录新的 OOM 现场与重启状态分裂，不声明它们是同一根因。

来源：用户实际使用反馈；OOM 证据由 ADX 负责人确认并经本轮转述。原始反馈渠道未核实，GitHub 是转录落单处，不作为 `channel:github` 依据。

1874.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Step HS0 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. v3.1 code keeps accumulating in Bridge `server_engine`: on main `c58b8609` there are 55 registered adapter files (11.4k LOC) and unregistered Hive code (`session_proximity/hive_store.py` 4.0k LOC, `hive_busy.py`, Hive wiring in `server.py`). Several registered adapters hold feature policy rather than translation (`hive_turn_startup.py` 1.3k, `hive_bee_execution.py` 1.0k, `hive_beebou_tools.py` 0.75k LOC). HS0 slows this growth **without blocking feature delivery**: until HS1 lands, every new `temp/` feature still needs a registered Bridge adapter.

### Design Ideas

Extend the architecture gate ([architecture-gate.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/migration/architecture-gate.md#transition-features-under-temp)):

| Rule | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New Bridge file that imports a `temp/` package or `server.*`, or is named for a v3.1 feature, and is not registered in any `temp/*/ownership.json` | Fail; fix is one registration row |
| Registered adapter above a configured line cap | Fail unless an owner-approved exemption is recorded; cap and exemptions live in gate configuration, not code |
| Growth of existing unregistered v3.1 files (`hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py`, `server.py` Hive wiring) | Warn and list in the gate report only |

Seed the exemption list with today's oversized adapters, each with an owner and the issue that moves its policy into `temp/`.

### Involved Public APIs

None. Gate configuration and report only.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Affects every PR touching `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine`. The warn-only list becomes the work list for HS2. HS4 later tightens this to refuse new Bridge adapters.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Gate tests for each rule: unregistered new file fails; registered file passes; oversized adapter fails without exemption and passes with one; growth of a listed unregistered file warns without failing.
- Run the gate against main `HEAD`: expect zero failures, with the exemption list and warning list matching the measured files.
- Confirm a representative feature PR (new `temp/` package + registered adapter) passes unchanged.

### Additional Information

Done when the gate reports on every PR, main passes, and each oversized adapter has an owner and follow-up issue.

1875.author: Jianyu010
1875.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Step HS1 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. `server/` has contracts and proxies but no host: the production entry is Bridge (`engine_cli.serve` → `server_engine/server.py`, which fills its own `_methods` table). `temp/` packages are libraries bundled into the Bridge wheel via `force-include`, so Bridge must construct each one and register its RPC methods. That is why every v3.1 feature leaves an adapter in Bridge.

### Design Ideas

Host inversion, in place, same process. **Start from the proven foundation host**, not a new design: [`codex/architecture-foundation` `server/__main__.py`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/77a92a218bb9f6775d826a53cd702cc19a0ffdfb/server/__main__.py) (`compose_runtime`, `start_runtime`) and [`server/runtime.py`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/77a92a218bb9f6775d826a53cd702cc19a0ffdfb/server/runtime.py), adapted to main's existing `server/agent_service` packages. Its Store and Router port later (HS2 data decision; Hive routing behaviour must be preserved).

- `server/agent_service` owns the process entry, lifecycle (startup, shutdown, recovery ordering) and the RPC method registry.
- `engine_cli.serve` becomes a thin call into it; `server.py` registers its existing methods through the registry instead of `_methods`.
- `temp/` assembly (for example `dm_hive_runtime.assembly`) is constructed by `server/` and receives Bridge services through declared ports.
- No behaviour change; method names, payloads and error codes are unchanged.

New exports of `server/agent_service` need their `module-ownership.json` change merged first, as the gate requires.

### Involved Public APIs

New: Agent Service host and method-registry interface in `server/agent_service`. Unchanged: every existing RPC method and event.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Bridge `server.py` / `engine_cli.py`, all `temp/` assembly entry points, the Bridge wheel packaging. Prerequisite for HS4 and for any #737 package that needs a new runtime wiring point.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Installed-wheel proof: the full existing RPC surface is registered and answers identically (method inventory diff is empty).
- Startup, shutdown, recovery bootstrap and hosted-session paths pass existing server UT/ST suites.
- A new sample `temp/` feature registers a method and receives its dependencies with no new file under `server_engine/`.

### Additional Information

Done when a new `temp/` feature needs no Bridge adapter to be hosted, and the existing surface behaves identically on the installed wheel.

Investigation that sizes step HS2 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. `session_proximity/hive_store.py` (4.0k LOC) writes almost only its own `dm_hive_*` tables but also references the legacy `submissions`, `history` and `messages` tables, through `EngineStore.transaction()` (`engine_workspace.py`). `EngineStore` is used by 26 non-test modules. Before moving Session/Hive store ownership into `server/agent_service/session_store`, we need to know which of those references must commit atomically with Hive rows.

### Design Ideas

Produce a short report (added to the cutover plan) covering:

1. Every reference in `hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py`, `hive_migrations.py` and the session parts of `repository.py` to a non-`dm_hive_*` table: read or write, and whether it shares a transaction with Hive writes.
2. Which modules outside the Session/Hive domain write the same tables.
3. Whether the existing participant pattern in `server/agent_service/session_store` (`legacy_admission.py`, `legacy_receipts.py`) can own the transaction for this domain over the existing workspace database file.
4. A recommended HS2 cut line and size estimate.

Constraint: keep the same database file. Do not split into an `ATTACH`ed file; in WAL mode SQLite commits each attached file atomically on its own.

### Involved Public APIs

None. Read-only investigation.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Blocks HS2 and the #737 packages that write Session/Hive state.

Report cites file:line for each classified reference, verified against a named main SHA. No code changes.

Done when the report is merged into the plan and HS2's scope is updated from it.

1877.author: Jianyu010
1877.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Step HS2 of the [Host and Store cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1870) (`docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md`), under #737. The sole writer of Session and Hive state is Bridge's `EngineStore`, so Hive store logic had to live in Bridge (`session_proximity/hive_store.py` 4.0k LOC, `hive_busy.py`, `hive_migrations.py`). `server/agent_service/session_store` already owns a separate DMS1 database and treats the hosted legacy format as a distinct transaction participant. Scope is set by the HS2 investigation issue.

### Design Ideas

[HS2 cut design](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/de56f973f8110f80815006eb68568aab6721f563/docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md#hs2-workspace-bootstrap-and-hive-writer-cut) covers the existing connection, Home PDF failure cases, rollback and the ownership transition.

- The Session Store owner in `server/` opens the existing workspace database as a registered participant and owns the transaction primitive for the Session/Hive domain. **Same file; code moves, rows stay.**
- Move `hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py`, `hive_migrations.py` and the session parts of `repository.py` into the Session Store owner. Tables, identities and migration order keep their bytes.
- Bridge callers switch to the Session Store public operations; any temporary Bridge shim is registered and removed in the same lane.
- Other `EngineStore` domains (people, consent, connectors, activity) stay put.

#### HS2a proposed cut

The [HS2a source trace](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1880)
found that the Hive names `submissions`, `history`, and `messages` are CTEs.
The production Home PDF hold writes shared Attachment records in the same
transaction as Hive admission. Session/History/Hive schema initialization also
shares one transaction. Preserve those boundaries and the original connection,
authority, savepoints, commit acknowledgements and outcome reconciliation.
Move the Session-owned claims, bootstrap and admission participants with the
Store or connect them through its narrow same-file operations.

### Involved Public APIs

New Session Store operations for the Session/Hive domain in `server/agent_service/session_store` (ownership change merged first). No RPC or client contract change.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Bridge `session_proximity`, `temp/hive-*` adapters, Hive recovery and retention. Prerequisite for #737 packages that write Session/Hive state, and for HS4.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Existing workspaces open without data migration; schema and migration fingerprints unchanged.
- Duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, Stop, unknown-outcome reconciliation and replay pass through the new owner on the installed wheel.
- Existing Hive server UT/ST suites pass; one local device/emulator run of Hive flows before merge.
- Static check: no write to a `dm_hive_*` table outside `server/agent_service/session_store`.

### Additional Information

HS1 and HS2a are merged. #2012 implements the first cut for Hive writers and shared schema bootstrap. #2009 prepares trusted ownership. The Session repository, admission, claims and coupled publication writers remain in scope. Done when every Session/Hive write goes through the Session Store owner in `server/`.

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] The failure reproduced on the named main baseline and the HS1 candidate.
- [x] The failing test, environment and reproduction are included.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The installed-wheel Bee journey accepts a Home send and enters the Bee path. It times out waiting for the terminal notice. The verifier records that the same runtime instance still holds the Run, but the turn named no runtime request. The Run stays RUNNING.

From the repository's scenario test directory with the vendored, patched WorkSwarm and Core wheels and the selected Server Contracts and Bridge wheels installed, run:

```sh
WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1 python -Im pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  hive/test_phase2_cli_bee_runtime.py::CliBeeRuntimeJourney::test_message_reaches_a_witnessed_bee_terminal_and_the_client_notice
```

| Revision | Observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Main `e6dc2954326a45807572714557f2d7e2988c7d5d` | Timed out in `ClientWebSocketResponse.receive_json` after the test's 120-second wait. The run logged a missing runtime-request witness. |
| HS1 `7425f2df10baa1856a41ae0d4a23a74a2a238231` | Same receive timeout and missing runtime-request witness. One separately selected runtime history-retention case passed. |

1887.author: Jianyu010
1887.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

HS4 in the [Host and Store cutover](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737) moves each transition partition to its established owner. On main `38595772`, Bee Artifact settings are a small first slice. The loader only validates an optional supplied TOML path or its bundled configuration. The artifact readers, notice and erasure workers, MCP catalogue and Hive document assembly consume it.

### Design Ideas

Draft for the first Hive Artifact partition of the [cutover plan](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/migration/host-and-store-cutover.md#hs4--drain-temp). Move the settings module and bundled TOML into `server/agent_service/artifacts`, switch its existing callers, and remove the obsolete transition component and caller grants. Follow the [architecture change review](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/protocols/feature-development.md) and pre-register the exact new owner paths and only the current checked caller edges.

- HS4-ART-D1. Artifact settings own their existing resource bytes and checked loader interface. The caller sequence is unchanged: startup/dispatch → notice, erasure or read consumer → validated artifact settings → existing reader, publisher or byte-owner port.
- HS4-ART-D2. The Artifact and workspace writers retain their existing wire values, defaults, state tables, byte locations and retry semantics. The settings loader never writes and the runtime change waits on HS1 and device acceptance.
- HS4-ART-D3. Remaining artifact partitions continue behind the existing Store, byte, notification and Tool operations. Track removal of their Bridge adapters, packaging map and registration in dependent slices after their destination callers are verified.

### Involved Public APIs

Existing settings loader signatures and value types under the Artifact owner module. Existing RPCs, provider boundaries and settings TOML data are preserved.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

The installed server contracts wheel owns the settings module and resource. The Bridge wheel retains the transition package for the remaining artifact core until those partitions move.

### Test Design and Test Plan

HS4-ART-T1. On installed wheels compare bundled defaults and original bytes and exercise rejection of malformed files with the existing assertions.

HS4-ART-T2. Run the existing artifact core, Bridge Host read, handoff and erasure selections. Use the actual Store/bytes where selected and report named fixtures.

HS4-ART-T3. Verify trusted architecture and package inventory, device send/history/continuation, and post-merge startup with the same artifacts.

1894.author: Jianyu010
1894.body:
### Background and Goal Description

用户希望从 Home 点击 Beebou，再点某只 Bee 的头像，进入该 Bee 的独立子对话。页面显示这只 Bee 的上下文和回复，底部提供常规对话框。用户可以回到 Beebou 继续讨论，Beebou 应能接上刚才在子对话里确认的需求、变更和结果。

`main@9486bdd0` 已有 #1243、#1603、#1605 的显式目标、会话历史及面板内定向发送。当前面板用「记录」展开历史和内嵌输入；现有定向路径已把路由动作及用户输入记入 Beebou 上下文。仍需交付独立对话界面，以及覆盖用户与 Bee 双向交流的 Inbox 摘要。现有 `status`、`done` 报告及问题答复知会提供了参考。 [HIVE 父设计 #1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) · [Worker 设计 #1268](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268)

### Proposed Solution

**设计提案 v0.1**

1. **D1 · 子对话。** Home → Beebou 弹窗 → 点某只 Bee 的头像 → 该 Bee 的专属页。标题显示 Bee 头像和名称，时间线和分页限定当前 Bee，底部有常规对话输入框。弹窗列表去掉内嵌的发消息选项。返回时回到 Beebou 弹窗。退役 Bee 在仍有授权和历史可读时可查看历史，输入框禁用。入口视觉见 #1893。
2. **D2 · 定向与历史。** 客户端用 `hive.activity` 读取会话，并通过 `hive.message.send` 携带显式 `target_session_ref`。服务端复核用户权限、Bee 绑定和会话代次。目标失效时给出明确反馈，保留输入草稿。设计评审明确忙时普通发送的默认语义，并保留现有显式补充、排队、抢占与问题答复各自的目标和回执。
3. **D3 · 摘要投递。** 每轮已受理的用户直聊及其 Bee 应答、已提交的可见结果或终止事实都纳入摘要覆盖。由 Bee 生成简明增量摘要，记录来源 Bee、会话和源消息范围，保留用户确认的约束变更、Bee 的结论、失败或停止以及未决事项。Bee/Host 经现有报告或知会边界交给 Session Manager / Store。Store 权威记录摘要及可恢复的投递义务，以稳定的源范围或轮次身份去重。Bee 回复可先展示。摘要暂时生成失败、丢 ACK 或重启时恢复同一义务，原始对话可继续读取。
4. **D4 · Beebou 消费。** 复用现有 Inbox 与上下文提交见证，把它作为知会数据投递。Beebou 后续读取已持久化的摘要，把它纳入正常轮上下文，提交后才确认消费。已到达的摘要须供下一次相关 Beebou 回复使用。对尚未交付的变更保留可区分的待同步事实。摘要到达本身不触发自动派单或补充任务，也不在 Home 自动重复展示原对话。
5. **接入与回退。** 优先沿用现有显式目标、分页和消费边界。需新增服务端核心时，按 v3.1 迁移规则放在对应 owner 的支持路径，支持路径未就绪时用已登记的 `temp/<feature>/` 过渡路径。以能力声明控制入口和升级顺序。回退界面时保留已有对话及已承诺的 Inbox 投递义务。

建议时序为「用户在 Bee 页发送 → Gateway 校验定向 → Bee 回复并提交源记录 → Bee/Host 提交摘要或可恢复义务 → Store 投递 Inbox → Beebou 正常轮读入并确认」。可评审复用现有知会类型或扩展受控报告类型。采用哪种类型、何时生成摘要、并发时如何保证覆盖，以及权限变化如何处理，由 Bee/Host、Session Manager/Store 和 Beebou owner 一起确认。

### Involved Public APIs

优先复用客户端已支持的 `hive.activity` 和 `hive.message.send` 显式目标。评审需确认摘要知会的类型、来源引用、去重键、确认点、兼容行为及能力声明。Session Store 持有持久会话、回执和 Inbox 的权威写入。App 使用已有公开代理读写会话。 [现有会话与知会规格 §7](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9486bdd00c065e1c01f248e76c473f475180f5a7/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-delivery-design.md)

### Test Verification

- **T1（D1、D2）** 实际 HarmonyOS HAP 从同一弹窗进入 Bee A 和 B，各自发送多轮并切换、返回、重开。验证历史、分页、回复和后续上下文只归对应 Bee。覆盖旧 HAP、已退休、目标过期及双设备各停留不同 Bee。
- **T2（D2）** 实际 Gateway / Store 验证越权及冲突目标被拒绝，且草稿可恢复。忙时发送、问题答复与重连重试按已评审的语义落到原目标。
- **T3（D3、D4）** 实际 Bee、Inbox 与 Beebou 串联。用户在 Bee A 改约束并收到 Bee 回复，随后回 Beebou 追问，检查持久 Inbox 记录、Beebou 实际轮次输入及回复是否采用最新约束。另验 Bee B 原始上下文和其他账号不可见。
- **T4（D3、D4）** 覆盖摘要生成失败、写入后丢 ACK、Bee 或 Beebou 重启、Inbox 消费提交前崩溃、快速连续多轮及退役交界。对账每个源轮及其终止事实都有摘要覆盖，重试后逻辑上只应用一次，且只读知会不会触发派单。
- 上述均为待验收用例。验收记录实际 HAP、Gateway / 服务端版本、参与方及回执，沿用 HIVE-SC-04 的显式目标与设备用例。 [HIVE G5 验收](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9486bdd00c065e1c01f248e76c473f475180f5a7/docs/scenarios/hive-g5-plan.md)

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

1895.author: huben0423-hw
1895.body:
### Context

移动端 Beebou Home 会话。用户发送「你好」后，Beebou 回复正常问候，但在括号中顺带输出系统运维信息：「（顺带一提：系统刚回收了「产品额度查询助手」来释放名额，不影响你手头的上海亲子游方案。要调整行程或导出 Word/Excel，随时说～）」

导航路径：Home 会话 → 输入「你好」→ Beebou 回复。

### Test Environment

- 服务端：`openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate` main 分支，2026-11-16/17 版本。
- 客户端：移动端 App，Beebou Home。
- 复现时间：2026-11-17 05:49（Asia/Shanghai）。

### Problem Description

Bee 的回收/驱逐通知是内部系统状态，应该静默记录或放在开发者/运维面板，而不是由对话助手以括号补充说明的形式主动告知终端用户。普通用户不需要知道哪个内部 Worker Bot 被回收；这类系统消息会：

1. 打断对话的自然流程，让助手看起来在“自言自语”；
2. 暴露内部实现细节（Bee 的名字、回收原因）；
3. 与用户当前对话目标无关，造成噪音。

截图中，用户只是发送「你好」，Beebou 的回复却包含系统回收「产品额度查询助手」的通知。用户认为这类系统信息不应出现在对话中。

### Improvement & Fix Suggestions

- 将 Bee 回收/驱逐、名额释放、容量管理等系统事件从对话输出中移除，改为仅记录在服务端日志、运维面板或开发者调试页面。
- 如果确实需要通知用户（例如用户正在等待的任务被取消），应以用户可理解的业务语言单独说明，而不是括号补充系统运维细节。
- 系统事件进入模型上下文时，应标记为 `role: system` 或内部数据，不应被模型自然语言化后复述给用户。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Beebou 在回复「你好」时顺带告知系统回收了「产品额度查询助手」](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-evidence-unified-capabilities-20261117/issues/assets/2026-11-17-unified-assistant-capabilities.png?raw=true)

### Version Information

- App 版本：未知，截图来自 2026-11-17 05:49（Asia/Shanghai）。
- 服务端：main 分支，2026-11-16/17。

1899.author: Jianyu010
1899.body:
### Background and Goal Description

[#1884](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1884) moves the Bee tool hook to the Host and retires the Hive overlay from WorkSwarm. An installed-wheel restart probe showed that an altered DeepAdapter source makes an old Registry core unavailable and deleting the overlay makes the old legacy WorkSwarm participant unavailable. Old bindings still resolve when the same installed inputs are present. Design compatibility for already retained work while preserving checkpoint, replay and authority guarantees.

### Proposed Solution

The [versioned specification](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/hs3-retained-binding-design/docs/implementations/migration/hs3-retained-binding-compatibility.md) and the [architecture review slides](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/hs3-retained-binding-design/docs/assets/feature-design/hs3-retained-binding-review-v0.1.pptx) are open for review in #1900.

Review a release-scoped compatibility design. Evaluate a trusted, bounded proof that connects exact original dependencies to a reviewed successor and retains the original recorded binding as the durable evidence. Consider retaining exact old inputs with a sunset and keeping the present unavailable behavior as separate options. Approve coverage and rollback semantics before any resolver change or persisted-data operation.

### Involved Public APIs

Hosted binding resolution and the WorkSwarm Registry factory boundary. Inspect the existing Bee Harness reference, current owner claim, context operations, tool admission, effect journal and client-visible recovery behavior.

### Test Verification

Reopen retained Registry Hosted, legacy Hosted and Hive Bee work across restarts using the installed wheels. Exercise same-session continuation, retained receipt replay, answer claims, lost receipts, effect reconciliation, Stop, unknown and forged transitions, mixed old and new participants, and rollback after new admissions. Measure differences through actual callers with controlled providers and a separate emulator acceptance.

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents
